name: Trainee Angel
description: An exquisitely crafted golden halo hovers overhead, flanked by a pair of small white wings that radiate a saintly glow.
story: Put this on, lie back serenely on a couch with your arms neatly folded over your chest, and enjoy the priceless look of sheer horror on your friends' faces as they push open the door.

source.description: Available at the Gift of Stardust store
